title: Microsoft 365 Ribbon & Quick Access
description: Master navigation across the unified Microsoft 365 Ribbon interface, Quick Access Toolbar, and Command Search.
objectives: Navigate ribbon tabs (Home, Insert, Layout, Design)

steps.title: The Microsoft 365 Ribbon Interface
steps.content: The Ribbon organizes commands into contextual tabs: Home for formatting, Insert for media/tables, Layout for margins, and View for display modes.

quiz.question: What is the primary function of the Quick Access Toolbar at the top of Office apps?
options: It holds frequently used one-click command icons like Save, Undo, and Redo regardless of active tab
quiz.explanation: The Quick Access Toolbar keeps essential commands accessible regardless of which ribbon tab is currently open.

title: Cloud Storage, AutoSave & Exporting (PDF/XLSX)
description: Configure OneDrive cloud backup, enable real-time AutoSave, and export documents as universal PDFs.
objectives: Export Word and Excel files as PDF
Manage local vs. cloud file storage

steps.title: Cloud AutoSave & Document Security
steps.content: When documents are stored on OneDrive, AutoSave saves edits every few seconds automatically, eliminating data loss.

quiz.question: Which requirement must be met for the AutoSave feature to function in Microsoft 365?
options: The document must be saved on OneDrive or SharePoint cloud storage
The computer must be plugged into power
The document must be saved as a .txt file
The document must contain at least 100 pages
quiz.explanation: AutoSave relies on cloud version synchronization available via OneDrive or SharePoint.

title: Real-time Co-authoring & Version History Pro
description: Collaborate simultaneously with team members, manage active user cursors, and restore previous version history points.
objectives: Share cloud files with view/edit permission links
Co-author documents in real-time with team cursors
Inspect and restore historical document versions

steps.title: Real-time Team Co-authoring
steps.content: Multiple users can edit the same Word document or Excel spreadsheet at the exact same time, with colored presence cursors showing live edits.

quiz.question: If a team member accidentally deletes a paragraph in a co-authored cloud file, how can you recover it?
options: Open File -> Info -> Version History and restore a previous autosaved checkpoint
Create a new document from scratch
quiz.explanation: Version History preserves checkpoints of all cloud saves, allowing seamless rollback to any previous version.
